$comment: Hand-curated after reviewing every frame. `src` is relative to _source/. Set `exclude` with a reason to drop a frame; `featured` marks the 12 strongest; `hero` orders the home reel. `focus` is the CSS object-position used when a frame is cropped. `grade` applies a consistent correction (used for the RAW lacrosse set).
